"# Design review: css: write the text-decoration and text-emphasis prefixes in place, and the image-set() fallback of list-style-image

Reviewed at head 09b81e3aa4 of `robobun/cf2a0e8e/css-text-decoration-handler` against origin/main: 12 files, +3,108/-53. Line numbers are at that head.

## 1. Disposition

**`supersede`**: the `-webkit-text-decoration` core is wanted and nothing else supplies it, but this branch bundles it with two fixes that have their own PRs, two features that change no real stylesheet, and a handler design that waits on a maintainer ruling nobody has given. Close it as a unit and cut a sequenced set of smaller PRs from it.

Desirability verdict: `wanted-in-a-different-shape` (confidence 0.88); pr_disposition: `rework`.

**Bigger shape.** The branch gives eight CSS property names typed rows: `text-decoration`, `-line`, `-style`, `-thickness`, `text-emphasis`, `-style`, `-position` and `list-style-image`. It adds a `TextDecorationHandler` to the declaration-handler chain, and carries two unrelated fixes (duplicate-rule detection, and the prefix inside `@import … supports()`). No PR was opened for it and five of its six commits are titled "wip", so nothing human-reviewed is lost by closing it. The set below has about the same total line count; only the handler is larger than the biggest css-only merge so far (+391, #31920).

1. **The two carried fixes leave.**

Main prints `@import "a.css" supports(-webkit-transition: all 1s)` as `supports((transition: all 1s))`, and a typed text-decoration row would lose `-webkit-text-decoration` the same way. A `supports(-webkit-text-decoration: …)` print test in the rows PR enforces the order.
2. **Rows PR, about +380.**

Add `handle_all`/`reset_for_all` from #42042 (about 75 lines). Together they replace the private `mark` scan and the new `other` parameter on `DeclarationHandler::handle_property` in `/workspace/bun/src/css/declaration.rs`.

## 2. Why

**The need is real and nobody else covers it.**

**The size is about eight times anything that has merged.**

**It carries third copies of two fixes.**
